text:
lucy: Quick decision thread 10m. Sales wants clarity on billing and consent model for BYOK exports + live audit access. Need one-page guidance we can give pilots.

omar: Short answer: separate billing for (1) managed-search, (2) export jobs, (3) dedicated unwrap windows. Make unwrap windows explicit line-item because they add ops risk.

vijay: Engineering note: export jobs cost = CPU (format/sign) + egress + optional TSA stamp. Recommend we charge by GB exported + a flat export-job fee. Unwrap windows require isolated runtime; bill per-hour for dedicated instance.

sarah: Compliance concern: we must capture explicit customer consent for any temporary unwrapping. Consent should include timebox, permitted auditors, and an acknowledgement of key-loss responsibility. No unwrap without signed consent.

lucy: Proposed one-pager structure to share with Sales:
- What we offer: managed live-search, export-only BYOK, temporary unwrap (timeboxed)
- Pricing bullets: base ingestion + retention tier + per-GB export + per-hour dedicated runtime
- Security guarantees: HSM unwrap, attestation log, no-token retention
- Contract ask: escrow optional; ephemeral unwrap requires signed consent

omar: Implementation checklist for product docs:
- sample API call for export: `POST /v1/audit/export { tenant, window, format: parquet }`
- response includes `export_id` and `resume_token`
- if unwrap requested: `POST /v1/audit/unwrap { export_id, unwrap_token, timebox }`
- attestation generated: `attestation://<export_id>` signed by HSM key

vijay: Infra sizing note: expect export CPU ~ 0.2s per MB for manifesting+signing. For a 50GB default cap that's ~10k CPU-seconds. Dedicated VM billing discounts should be explicit.

sarah: Legal redlines to include in consent: operator identity (who ran unwrap), limited retention of ephemeral keys (destroyed), and indemnity cap. Also require a notarized attestation delivered after the run.

lucy: Decision ask: can we standardize a pilot-friendly consent that removes escrow but permits ephemeral unwrap under strict constraints? Sales will use that to keep pilots moving.

omar: Yes, but limit pilots to single-tenant isolated runtime and mandatory sec tests (zeroization and crash recovery). Otherwise deny.

vijay: Also require perf targets for pilot: exporter must finish 7d hot-window bundle for up to 1k eps tenant within 3h, and we must surface ETA in UI.

sarah: Add a checkbox: customer must accept that if they refuse escrow and lose keys, Redwood can't recover encrypted archives. We'll include sample attestation text for transparency.

lucy: Ops automation to include: create ephemeral runtime, run unwrap job, capture `attestation.json` (sha256, signer, timestamp), auto-destroy runtime. Make this a single-button flow in console for pilots.

omar: I'll scope a small feature flag `pilot_ephemeral_unwrap` and an ops playbook. I'll open ticket PLG-7122 with subtasks.

compliance-bot: Created ticket PLG-7122 "pilot-ephemeral-unwrap-and-billing-model" assigned to @omar,@sarah due 1746920000. Link: https://rwd/ticket/PLG-7122

lucy: Acceptance criteria for the one-pager + pilot offer:
- clear pricing table (ingest, retention, export per-GB, unwrap per-hour)
- consent template + attestation sample included
- console flow: request export -> provide unwrap token -> show ETA -> deliver attestation
- security gated: isolated runtime + HSM unwrap + zeroization smoke test

vijay: Add monitoring signals: export job success rate, attestation generation time, ephemeral-runtime lifecycle events, and billing-metering logs. Hook to billing pipeline.

sarah: Legal will produce the consent template by EOD Thu. I'll also flag required indemnity language and recommended default limits (timebox <= 8 hours, one operator).

lucy: Great. If all sign off, Sales can share the one-pager with pilots next week. We'll revisit full BYOK live-search as a paid enterprise feature after we validate pilot controls. :thumbsup:
